method: Parse with the minimal compatibility candidate, normalize the parse tree to deterministic JSON, hash with SHA-256. This is a parser/canonicalization probe only, not ClayCode's final semantic_hash or provenance-bound contract_hash.
interpretation: Whitespace/comment variation can be erased before deterministic canonical identity in this tested surface, while a tested type-semantic change remains distinguishable. This supports proceeding to a typed canonical IR without claiming the final semantic identity contract is solved.
falsifier: Complete-corpus canonicalization reveals two meaningfully different programs with the same canonical IR/hash, or equivalent admitted programs with unstable canonical identity.
